fem.name: Feminine form of the first declension

transforms.name: common form
transforms.description: A common form that other rules read first as a rarer word, read as the term the dictionary alone puts first (ἔλεγε → λέγω, not ἔλεγος; ἐμοῦ → ἐγώ, not ἐμός; ἔτη → ἔτος, not ἔτης).

transforms.name: nominative/accusative plural
transforms.description: Nominative, accusative and vocative plural of neuters: -α, -η.

transforms.name: Epic -φι
transforms.description: Epic -φι(ν), the instrumental and locative ending of Homer (βίηφι, θεόφιν, ὄρεσφι).

transforms.name: Ionic η
transforms.description: Ionic η where Attic has ᾱ (χώρη, ἡμέρη → χώρα, ἡμέρα).

transforms.name: Doric ᾱ
transforms.description: Doric and Aeolic ᾱ where Attic has η, in Pindar and the lyrics of tragedy (δίκα, ἄταν, ψυχᾶς → δίκη, ἄτη, ψυχή). Optional: the doricAlpha setting turns it on.

transforms.name: feminine
transforms.description: Feminine of an adjective, pronoun or participle: -η, -α, -εια, -εσσα, -ασα, -ουσα → masculine -ος, -υς, -εις, -ας, -ων.

transforms.name: neuter
transforms.description: Neuter of an adjective or pronoun: -ον, -ες, -υ, -εν, -αν, -ο → masculine -ος, -ης, -υς, -εις, -ας, -ων.

transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: A form of a word listed in the plural (χίλιοι, τριακόσιοι, μύριοι): -ων, -οις, -ους, -αι, -ας, -α → -οι.

transforms.name: adverb
transforms.description: Adverb of manner in -ως made from an adjective (σοφῶς, δικαίως, ἀληθῶς, ταχέως); comparative adverb in -τερον, superlative in -τατα.

transforms.name: future
transforms.description: Future: -σω, -ψω, -ξω, -ήσω, -ώσω, contracted -ῶ of liquid verbs → the present.

transforms.name: aorist
transforms.description: Aorist: the σ-stem (ἔλυσα, ἔπεμψα, ἔπραξα, ἐποίησα), the liquid stem (ἔμεινα, ἤγγειλα, ἔφηνα) and second aorists (ἔλαβον, ἦλθον) → the present.

transforms.name: aorist passive
transforms.description: Aorist passive: -θην, -φθην, -χθην, -σθην, -ήθην, second aorist passive -ην → the present.

transforms.name: future passive
transforms.description: Future passive: -θήσομαι, -ήσομαι → the aorist passive stem.

transforms.name: perfect
transforms.description: Perfect active: -κα, -ηκα, -φα, -χα and strong perfects → the present.

transforms.name: perfect
transforms.description: A form of a verb whose dictionary form is its perfect (πεπνυμένος → πέπνυμαι, δεδοικότες → δέδοικα).

transforms.name: perfect middle/passive
transforms.description: Perfect middle and passive of vowel stems: λέλυμαι, πεποίημαι, τετίμημαι, δεδήλωμαι, ἠκούσμην → the present.

transforms.name: imperfect
transforms.description: Imperfect with an irregular augment (εἶχον, ἑώρων, εἱπόμην, ἤθελον, ἠβουλόμην).

transforms.name: augment
transforms.description: Past tense (imperfect, aorist, pluperfect): removes the augment ἐ- or the lengthened first vowel (ἔλυον, ἦγον, ᾤκουν, ηὗρον), also after a preverb (ἀπέλυσα, ἀνήχθη, συνέβαλον).

transforms.name: unaugmented
transforms.description: A past tense without a visible augment: Homer and Ionic often omit it, and verbs beginning with ι, υ, η, ω, ει or ου do not show it.

transforms.name: reduplication
transforms.description: Perfect stem: removes the reduplication (λέλυκα, πεπαίδευκα, γέγραφα, τέθηκα, ἔσταλκα, ἤγγελκα).

transforms.name: reduplication
transforms.description: Perfect stem of a compound verb: removes the reduplication after the preverb (ἀπολέλυκα, καταλέλοιπα, συγγέγραφα, ἐκπέπτωκα).

transforms.name: present
transforms.description: Present indicative of an athematic (-μι) verb.

transforms.name: perfect
transforms.description: Perfect of an athematic (-μι) verb or of οἶδα.

transforms.name: pluperfect
transforms.description: Pluperfect of an athematic (-μι) verb or of οἶδα.

transforms.name: middle/passive
transforms.description: Middle and passive of an athematic (-μι) verb.

transforms.name: aorist passive
transforms.description: Aorist passive of an athematic (-μι) verb.

transforms.name: compound
transforms.description: The dictionary form of a compound of ἵστημι or ἵημι: the preverb before a rough breathing (καταστήσας → καθίστημι, ἀπέστη → ἀφίστημι, ἀφεῖναι → ἀφίημι).

transforms.name: present (-αμαι)
transforms.description: Present system of an athematic -αμαι verb: -ασαι, -αται, -άμεθα, -ασθε, -ανται, -άμην, -ατο, -αντο, -ασθαι, -άμενος.

transforms.name: article
transforms.description: The definite article ὁ, ἡ, τό.

transforms.name: pronoun
transforms.description: Forms of the article, pronouns and numerals, which have paradigms of their own.

transforms.name: numeral
transforms.description: Forms of the numerals εἷς, δύο, τρεῖς, τέτταρες and of οὐδείς, μηδείς.

transforms.name: impersonal verb
transforms.description: Forms of the impersonal verbs χρή and δεῖ.

transforms.name: irregular noun
transforms.description: Nouns whose stems change (υἱός, γυνή, ἀνήρ, Ζεύς, ναῦς, βοῦς, πούς, γῆ, ὗς).

transforms.name: irregular adjective
transforms.description: Forms of μέγας and πολύς, whose stems change.

transforms.name: comparison
transforms.description: Irregular comparatives and superlatives: a form of one the dictionary lists reads as it (ἀμείνονος → ἀμείνων, πλείους → πλείων, μεγίστη → μέγιστος), another as the positive (καλλίονα → καλός).

transforms.name: spelling
transforms.description: A dictionary form in another spelling: -σσω for -ττω and back (πράττω, πράσσω), γιγν- for γιν- (γίνομαι, γιγνώσκω).

transforms.name: spelling
transforms.description: The older spelling ξυν- for συν- (Thucydides and tragedy: ξυμφορά, ξυνίημι).

transforms.name: elision
transforms.description: An elided final vowel (δ’ → δέ, ἀλλ’ → ἀλλά, γένοιτ’ → γένοιτο, ταῦτ’ → ταῦτα; before a rough breathing θ’, φ’, χ’ for τ’, π’, κ’: ἐφ’, καθ’, νύχθ’).

transforms.name: crasis
transforms.description: Crasis: καί, the article or ὦ merged with the next word (κἀγώ = καὶ ἐγώ, κἀν, κοὐ, χὠ = καὶ ὁ, τοὔνομα = τὸ ὄνομα, τἀγαθά, τἄλλα, ταὐτό, οὑμός = ὁ ἐμός).

transforms.name: enclitic accent
transforms.description: The second accent an enclitic gives the word before it (ἄνθρωπός τις, σῶμά τι, ἔχουσί τινες → ἄνθρωπος, σῶμα, ἔχουσι).

transforms.name: enclitic
transforms.description: An enclitic as its dictionary form writes it: ποτε → ποτέ.

transforms.name: enclitic particle
transforms.description: The particle -περ written onto the word before it (οὗπερ, ἧσπερ, ἐπείπερ, ὅσπερ).

transforms.name: accent
transforms.description: Puts back the dictionary form's accent where a rule removed the syllable that carried it (ἔλυσα → λυω → λύω, λυόμενος → λύω, θεοῦ → θεος → θεός): the recessive accent of a verb; the accent of a noun or adjective on its last syllable or, before a short last syllable, further back.
